UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private pilot profile and logbook configuration isolated to a single authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning pilot (immutable).

email.description: Verified email address of the owning pilot.

pilotName.description: Display name or callsign of the pilot.

baselineJson.description: Optional serialized brought-forward career baseline summary.

connectedSheetJson.description: Optional serialized Google Sheets link metadata (never stores OAuth tokens).

theme.description: Optional UI theme preference persisted per pilot ('light' or 'dark').

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace profile was last updated.

Flight.title: Flight
Flight.description: A single private flight logbook sortie belonging exclusively to one pilot.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning pilot (immutable).

id.description: Document identifier for this flight entry.

date.description: Sortie date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format.

aircraftType.description: Aircraft type designation (e.g., A-JET, L-39ZA, K8-E, SMK, DA-40).

aircraftMark.description: Aircraft mark / tail number (e.g., NAF 455, NAF 357).

sortie.description: Optional sortie number or identifier from the Flights tab.

totalMinutes.description: Total flight duration in integer minutes (0..1440).

dualMinutes.description: Dual instruction duration in integer minutes (0..1440).

soloMinutes.description: Solo / PIC duration in integer minutes (0..1440).

nightMinutes.description: Night flight duration in integer minutes (0..1440).

instrumentMinutes.description: Instrument flight duration in integer minutes (0..1440).

simulatorMinutes.description: Simulator session duration in integer minutes (0..1440).

customFieldsJson.description: Optional serialized extra columns preserved from Google Sheets / AppSheet.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the flight record was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the flight record was last updated.

Aircraft.title: Aircraft
Aircraft.description: An aircraft type and its tracked airframe marks belonging exclusively to one pilot.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning pilot (immutable).

type.description: Short aircraft type code (e.g., A-JET, L-39ZA, K8-E).

marks.description: Bounded list (max 50) of known airframe marks / tail numbers.

notes.description: Optional pilot notes about the aircraft type.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the aircraft record was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the aircraft record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private pilot profile and logbook metadata strictly isolated to userId.

/users/{userId}/flights/{flightId}.description: Private flight logbook entries strictly isolated to userId.

/users/{userId}/aircraft/{aircraftId}.description: Private aircraft fleet types and marks strictly isolated to userId.
